definitions.explanation: The decade of age from 20 to 29 years old. Used to refer to a person's age range or a group of people in that age bracket.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{二十代|にじゅうだい}だ。
{二十代|にじゅうだい}のうちに{海外|かいがい}に{行|い}きたい。
examples.english: I want to go abroad while I'm still in my twenties.

examples.japanese: {二十代|にじゅうだい}{前半|ぜんはん}で{結婚|けっこん}する{人|ひと}は{最近|さいきん}{少|すく}なくなっている。
examples.english: Fewer people have been getting married in their early twenties recently.

notes:
Formed from {二十|にじゅう} (twenty) + {代|だい} (generation, age bracket). The {代|だい} suffix is used with multiples of ten to indicate an age range.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二十代|にじゅうだい}{前半|ぜんはん}: early twenties (20-24)
- {二十代|にじゅうだい}{後半|こうはん}: late twenties (25-29)
- {二十代|にじゅうだい}{半|なか}ば: mid-twenties
- {二十代|にじゅうだい}の{男性|だんせい}/{女性|じょせい}: men/women in their twenties

COMMON PATTERNS:
The same pattern applies to other decades: {三十代|さんじゅうだい} (thirties), {四十代|よんじゅうだい} (forties), {五十代|ごじゅうだい} (fifties), etc. For teens, {十代|じゅうだい} covers ages 10-19.
